basic_info.description: Prepare to be blown away by this bright 2 bedroom/2 bath corner unit on Potrero Hill's coveted North Slope. Upon entering the home you're greeted by soaring high ceilings and sunlit windows. The expansive, open-concept living and dining area flows effortlessly, offering versatile space for any furniture layoutperfect for entertaining or relaxing To your right, up a short staircase, discover the enormous primary bedroomroom enough for a king-size bed, side tables, dressers, and a sitting area or office nook. It also includes an organized walk‑in closet and an ensuite bath. Back through the great room and down another short flight of stairs is the newly refreshed kitchen, a second full bathroom, and a convenient in‑unit washer/dryer along with a 2nd, much smaller, bedroom. This home includes an assigned parking in the common garage below, complete with a storage cage right in front of the space. You might not need your car that much considering this property's 96 Walk Score - a Walker's Paradise, 72 Transit Score - Excellent Transit, and 65 Bike Score - Bikeable. Live in one of San Francisco's sunnier, friendlier neighborhoodswhere 18th Street's cafes and bars, parks, and scenic views are just minutes away.
